unmodelled.text: Must have been street vending in an urban area on or before 24 March 2020
unmodelled.source_quote: Street vendors operating in urban areas as on or before March 24, 2020.

unmodelled.text: Must be identified in the local body's survey or hold a vending certificate or licence
unmodelled.source_quote: Vendors identified in survey conducted by Urban Local Bodies or possessing vending certificate/license.

unmodelled.text: Or be recommended by the local body or Town Vending Committee
unmodelled.source_quote: Vendors recommended by ULBS or Town Vending Committees.

unmodelled.text: Vendors from peri-urban or rural areas count if they vend inside urban limits
unmodelled.source_quote: Vendors in peri-urban or rural areas vending within urban boundaries.

unmodelled.text: Meant for street vendors from economically weaker sections
unmodelled.source_quote: Street vendors belonging to economically weaker sections including hawkers, fruit sellers, vegetable vendors, artisans and service providers.
